name: Sales Order Accurate
script:
# siapkan list items
items = []
for d in doc.items:   # loop child table Sales Invoice di ERPNext
    items.append({
        "itemNo": d.custom_item_code_accurate,
        "unitPrice": d.rate,
        "quantity": d.qty,
        "detailName": d.item_name,
        #"warehouseName": d.warehouse
    })
"""Jika Sudah Ada Maka Sifat nya Update """

id = ""
if doc.custom_sales_order_id_accurate:
    id=doc.custom_sales_order_id_accurate
    
res = frappe.call(
    "frappe_accurate.api.sales_order.save_do",
    customerNo=doc.custom_customerno,
    items=items,
    id=id,
    #statusName=doc.custom_statusname
)

if res['s'] == True:
    doc.db_set("custom_sales_order_number_accurate", res['r']['number'])
    doc.db_set("custom_sales_order_id_accurate", res['r']['id'])
    doc.db_set("custom_statusname", res['r']['statusName'])
    
frappe.log_error("Accurate Create Sales Order Response",str(res))
